title: We Knew Who We Were: Memories of the Minneapolis Jewish Northside
original_title: We Knew Who We Were: Memories of the Minneapolis Jewish Northside
overview: An affectionate portrait of the Jewish time and space that was the North Side - a beautiful bridge that carried a community from the shtetls of the Old World to the suburbs of the New World. We Knew Who We Were is a classic example of the American Jewish experience as well as one that relates to the experience of all immigrant communities.
